authority: A1 adjudicates freeze ambiguities; lanes never improve the spec silently

A4_Q1_no_older_quote_resurrection.reason: resurrecting an older quote after the latest goes stale would hide staleness, violating observable fail-closed behavior (plan section 6.4/7.3); a stale venue-local is skipped and counted

A4_Q2_consolidation_reference_currency.reason: deterministic, order-independent reference-currency rule accepted (currency of fresh venue-local with lexicographically smallest venue name; None pairs only with None)
A4_Q2_consolidation_reference_currency.correction: A1 integration correction: the consolidated result must RECORD the chosen reference currency (add to the result dict) so currency exclusion is observable, not silent

A4_Q3_tca_asof_boundaries.reason: as-of window [t-threshold, t] inclusive on both bounds is the natural known-at-decision-time semantics; boundary equality counts fresh

A4_Q4_total_cost_components.reason: total_cost_view sums decision-to-fill slippage + fees + funding only; effective/realized spread and impact are diagnostic decompositions and summing them would double-count

A4_Q5_views_ignore_rejected.reason: INVALID/QUARANTINED events may never re-enter accepted views (fail-closed hygiene)

A3_Q1_null_sequence_sort_sentinel.reason: null sequence_number (legal only under sequence_semantics=NONE) sorts via sentinel -1 before all legal seq>=0; exchange_time dominates the order key anyway, so the sentinel only disambiguates same-timestamp ties deterministically

A3_Q2_created_utc_type.reason: canonical produced type is int UTC ns matching sibling time fields; validation tolerates non-empty str input, never emits it

A3_Q3_sequence_semantics_closed_set.reason: {CONTIGUOUS, NONE} is the frozen set; anything else fails closed

A3_Q4_event_manifest_sha256_definition.reason: event.manifest_sha256 references the UPSTREAM RETRIEVAL manifest (provider-fetch attestation from which the event was normalized), NOT the archive-layer chunk storage manifest; the self-reference is a real fixed-point impossibility and the two manifest layers are distinct concepts

A3_Q5_prev_next_chain_one_direction.reason: bidirectional self-hashed chains are an unsolvable fixed point; real chains populate one direction and verify_chain checks each non-null link against the actual neighbor, both directions nullable

A3_Q6_duplicate_no_callback_raises.reason: unhandled duplicate input without a quarantine callback raises CorruptReplayInput (fail-closed default); with callback, first streams and second routes with DUPLICATE_EVENT

A2_Q1_manifest_sha256_nullability.reason: provenance is the plane's core promise: event.manifest_sha256 (upstream retrieval manifest per A3_Q4 ruling) is REQUIRED 64-hex in @1; null not permitted
A2_Q1_manifest_sha256_nullability.correction: A1 integration correction: validator must reject null manifest_sha256

A2_Q2_non_finite_sizes.reason: reason_codes@1 is frozen without a size-specific code; non-finite price -> NON_FINITE_PRICE, non-finite size -> MALFORMED_SHAPE

A2_Q3_side_enum.reason: canonical side enum is 'buy'|'sell'|null (lowercase); null only where the source provides no aggressor side

A2_Q4_null_seq_in_event_id.reason: empty string for null sequence_number in the 0x1F identity string is deterministic and documented

A2_Q5_sequence_semantics_set.reason: {CONTIGUOUS, NONE} only in @1; an evidenced-reset marker would be a schema bump

A2_Q6_construction_quality_default.reason: QUARANTINED as the construction default is maximally fail-closed: an unevaluated event can never silently enter an accepted stream; set_quality() from evaluate() is the only promotion path

A2_Q7_time_order_before_hash_check.reason: structural truth (IMPOSSIBLE_TIME_ORDER) raised before the supplied-event_id check so a stale hash cannot mask it
